rongmei.title: He kalvary chingkao mei ru khou

lines: 1. He! Kalvary ching kaumei ruh khou,
Kanlou meipu ryanra khaeng lou kan the;
Kandi mei khang thukpui zeihaeng luang mei.
He! Zaiguang lou o ching but rukhou,
Zaat guai khou ti thay lou o,
Rih mei nun rui nang thei lai ni,
Rih ngam pui lu suan puni.
2. Apap guai na tei khiu than lou the,
Rei khou pap zing mei bam khou rui ,
Mikdui keimei le zaengsimei khou rui,
Pou rui thuak patlou the nzian na.
3. Kros rukhou nthuk pui zei luang kei
Karam rianra tei ai ning ngam makge;
Charin e khanglou mei ta ning lou na,
Lung ryanra meirui kandih zing the.
4. Saopirun run lou na sin nui e,
Kalung rianra na kau kandi phaeng e;
Adi su cho? Khaeng lou kan mei zam tei,
Paap ta ngam ma kau kandih zuan the.
